description: Quote a Robinhood Chain trade WITHOUT executing - no signing, no funds moved, no guardrail. Buy a token with native ETH or sell it back to ETH, routed through Uniswap V3 (NOXA Fun pools). Returns expected output, min output after slippage, pool fee, USD estimate, and whether the token is a verified NOXA launch. Use this to preview a trade before calling xpay_trade. `from`/`to` are 'ETH' or an ERC-20 contract address (or a trending symbol); exactly one side must be ETH.

amount.description: Amount of the input token, human units (e.g. 0.01).

from.description: Input: 'ETH' or an ERC-20 contract address / trending symbol.

to.description: Output: 'ETH' or an ERC-20 contract address / trending symbol.

name: xpay_trade_quote
